alert: Request rate and latency spiking on frontend-proxy

root_cause.summary: The accounting service is experiencing very high processing latency (up to 15 seconds) for order consumption, causing downstream latency spikes observed at the frontend-proxy. No errors are reported, but traces show the accounting span dominates the latency.

evidence.why_it_matters: accounting shows SLOW status with p95 latency 15000ms
accounting order-consumed span takes >5s self time, indicating internal slowness

proposed_action.reason: accounting service latency is high, likely due to stuck state or DB connection issue

timeline.event: Alert received: Request rate and latency spiking on frontend-proxy

prevention: Add health checks and auto-restart on prolonged latency, or investigate DB query performance
